intro: Kent Heights is a single 32-storey BTO block on Owen Road in Kallang/Whampoa, listed by a third-party tracker as 430 flats of 2-room Flexi and 4-room types. One block means one set of lifts for every renovation. Below: key facts, what owners usually change, a defects check and how to plan your Kent Heights renovation.
whatsapp_text: Hi Maison, I'm collecting keys at Kent Heights and would like to discuss the renovation.

sections.heading: What to know about Kent Heights
sections.text:
When every renovation in a project shares the same lifts, materials deliveries and debris removal need careful scheduling. Your contractor should plan deliveries around the lift bookings and protect the lift and corridor as required.

The 2-room Flexi and 4-room mix suits seniors, singles and young families. High floors in a central location often have good views, so plan the living room around the window: low furniture, a TV wall that doesn't block the view, and blinds that control the afternoon sun.

sections.heading: What owners usually change
bullets: Living rooms planned around the window and the view.
2-room Flexi: compact storage and safe, slip-resistant finishes.
Blinds or curtains for sun control on high floors.
Toilet upgrades with tiles overlaid on the existing ones (no hacking in the first 3 years).

timeline_note: Plan on about 8 to 12 weeks from keys to move-in for a full renovation. Allow extra time if the lifts are heavily booked.

faq.q: When can I collect keys at Kent Heights?
faq.a: Your HDB notification gives your date. A third-party tracker estimates completion in 2026, but HDB has not confirmed a project-wide date on the pages we checked.

faq.q: Does a single block make renovation slower?
faq.a: It can, because every flat shares the same lifts. A contractor who plans deliveries early keeps your schedule on track.

faq.q: What are the noisy work hours?
faq.a: HDB allows noisy works, such as hacking and tile cutting, only Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.
